description: We are enthusiastic students passionate about space exploration and NASA missions. Through Space Explorer – Forgotten Missions, we aim to create an interactive platform showcasing NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. Our project will explore mission history, explain why equipment was left behind, and highlight scientific discoveries through images, interactive maps, and engaging storytelling. Our goal is to make space exploration interesting and educational for everyone.
summary:
Space Explorer – Forgotten Missions is an interactive web-based educational platform developed to highlight the abandoned equipment, historical missions, and forgotten stories of human exploration on the Moon and Mars.

Our project addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge theme, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," by bringing attention to the spacecraft, rovers, landing hardware, and scientific equipment left behind during space missions. Using an interactive mission explorer, visitors can explore the Moon and Mars, discover equipment stories, learn about mission histories, view historical images, and explore landing locations with coordinates and links to official NASA resources.

The project is important because space exploration is not only about successful landings and discoveries but also about the objects and scientific history left behind. By presenting this information in an engaging and accessible way, Space Explorer encourages curiosity, scientific awareness, and appreciation for humanity's achievements in space exploration.
details:
Space Explorer – Forgotten Missions is an interactive, web-based educational platform created to bring attention to abandoned space equipment and the forgotten stories of human exploration on the Moon and Mars.

The project allows users to explore historic space missions through an interactive interface. Users can switch between the Moon and Mars, discover important mission locations, view their coordinates, and access location links. Each mission provides information about its history, landing site, and equipment left behind. The platform also includes mission timelines, image galleries, detailed story panels, historical information, and mission statistics to make space exploration easier and more engaging to understand.

Our project addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge theme, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," by highlighting the spacecraft, lunar rovers, landing hardware, and other equipment that remain on celestial bodies after missions. It helps users understand that even when a mission ends, the objects and scientific contributions left behind continue to have historical and scientific value.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, HTML, and CSS. Visual assets and mission information were referenced from NASA and NASA/JPL-Caltech resources. The website was deployed using Vercel to make it publicly accessible.

The creative aspect of our project is its combination of space exploration, interactive mission discovery, historical storytelling, and educational content in one platform. Instead of simply presenting mission facts, it encourages users to explore the forgotten objects and understand the stories behind them.

The intended impact is to increase public awareness of space exploration history, inspire students and space enthusiasts, and preserve interest in the scientific and historical importance of equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

ChatGPT was used as an AI assistance tool during project development for brainstorming, coding guidance, debugging support, and preparation of descriptive content. The team reviewed, tested, and adapted the suggestions while developing the final project.
